lead: Waheeda Rehman is best known as an Indian film actor, born on 3 February 1938 in Chengalpattu.
As of 2026, she is 88 years old, and her birth date places her under the Aquarius sign.
She is associated with work such as Pyaasa, Kaagaz Ke Phool and Chaudhvin Ka Chand and has been recognised with Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award and Padma Bhushan.
